versions.content: The RTE Generator in Generation Phase shall provide the BswModuleDependency in the BswModuleDescription with the role bswMod- uleDependency for each API called by the RTE in another Basic Software Module. The reference from the BswModuleDependency to the BswModuleEntry shall be in the role calledEntry . The called Basic Software Module is specified in the attribute targetModuleId of the BswModuleDependency .
